examples.en: Delete any dodgy text link asking for bank passwords over urgent weekend messages.
examples.vi: Hãy xóa ngay mọi tin nhắn đáng ngờ kèm đường dẫn đòi mật khẩu ngân hàng vào dịp cuối tuần.
examples.ipaUs: /dɪˈlit ˈɛ.ni ˈdɑ.dʒi tɛkst lɪŋk ˈæ.skɪŋ fɔr bæŋk ˈpæ.swɝdz ˈoʊ.vɚ ˈɝ.dʒənt ˈwi.ˌkɛnd ˈmɛ.sɪ.dʒɪz/

examples.en: Carpenters replaced the dodgy bottom porch step so Grandma walks outside steadily every morning.
examples.vi: Thợ mộc đã thay bậc thềm dưới ọp ẹp để bà ngoại bước ra vườn vững vàng mỗi sáng.
examples.ipaUs: /ˈkɑr.pən.tɚz rɪˈpleɪst ðə ˈdɑ.dʒi ˈbɑ.təm pɔrtʃ stɛp soʊ ˈɡræn.ˌmɑ wɔks ˈaʊt.ˌsaɪd ˈstɛ.də.li ˈɛ.vri ˈmɔr.nɪŋ/

words.vi: lặt vặt vụn vặt mất thì giờ mà không đáng kể (thủ tục rườm rà, món tiền lẻ không bõ bèn)
words.senseNote: Nhấn âm đầu /ˈfɪd-/; hai âm tiết gọn giống fiddly (lắt nhắt khó thao tác).

examples.en: Clear kitchen apps eliminated fiddling paper coupons that used to clutter customer checkouts.
examples.vi: Ứng dụng gọn nhẹ loại bỏ mớ phiếu giấy vụn vặt từng làm rối quầy thanh toán.
examples.ipaUs: /klɪr ˈkɪ.tʃən æps ɪˈlɪ.mə.ˌneɪ.tɪd ˈfɪd.lɪŋ ˈpeɪ.pɚ ˈku.ˌpɑnz ðæt juzd tu ˈklʌ.tɚ ˈkʌ.stə.mɚ ˈtʃɛ.ˌkaʊts/

examples.en: Skip fiddling tiny border edits for now and verify the main roof timber measurements first.
examples.vi: Tạm bỏ qua mấy chỉnh sửa viền vụn vặt đi và kiểm tra số đo chính của xà gỗ mái nhà trước đã.
examples.ipaUs: /skɪp ˈfɪd.lɪŋ ˈtaɪ.ni ˈbɔr.dɚ ˈɛ.dɪts fɔr naʊ ænd ˈvɛ.rə.ˌfaɪ ðə meɪn ruf ˈtɪm.bɚ ˈmɛ.ʒɚ.mənts fɝst/

words.vi: được lý tưởng hóa đẹp đẽ hoàn hảo hơn thực tế nhiều lần (tranh vẽ, ký ức tuổi thơ)
words.senseNote: Nhấn chính âm tiết thứ hai /-ˈdi-/; bốn âm tiết mạch lạc giống hệt danh từ ideal thêm -ized.

examples.en: Vintage train travel posters showed idealized snow-free cottages nestled beside glowing lakes.
examples.vi: Áp phích du lịch tàu hỏa xưa vẽ những ngôi nhà tranh đẹp như mơ không một chút bùn tuyết bên mặt hồ rực nắng.
examples.ipaUs: /ˈvɪn.tɪdʒ treɪn ˈtræ.vəl ˈpoʊ.stɚz ʃoʊd aɪˈdi.ə.ˌlaɪzd ˈsnoʊ.fri ˈkɑ.tə.dʒɪz ˈnɛ.səld bɪˈsaɪd ˈɡloʊ.ɪŋ leɪks/

examples.en: Warm memoirs often offer an idealized view of quiet childhood summers without mosquito bites.
examples.vi: Hồi ký ấm áp thường phác họa một góc nhìn được tô hồng lý tưởng về những mùa hè tuổi thơ không muỗi đốt.
examples.ipaUs: /wɔrm ˈmɛ.mwɑrz ˈɔ.fən ˈɔ.fɚ æn aɪˈdi.ə.ˌlaɪzd vju ʌv ˈkwaɪ.ət ˈtʃaɪld.ˌhʊd ˈsʌ.mɚz wɪˈðaʊt məˈski.toʊ baɪts/

words.vi: liên quan đến địa ngục trong văn học cổ; phiền phức khó chịu kinh khủng (tiếng còi báo động inh ỏi)
words.senseNote: Nhấn âm tiết thứ hai /-ˈfɝ-/; đồng hành nhẹ nhàng trong khẩu ngữ văn học để phàn nàn tiếng ồn dai dẳng.

examples.en: Mechanics silenced that infernal squeaking fan belt inside our yellow delivery truck by lunch.
examples.vi: Thợ máy đã xử lý dứt điểm tiếng dây curoa kêu rít khó chịu kinh khủng trong chiếc xe tải giao hàng trước giờ trưa.
examples.ipaUs: /məˈkæ.nɪks ˈsaɪ.lənst ðæt ɪnˈfɝ.nəl ˈskwi.kɪŋ fæn bɛlt ɪnˈsaɪd ˈaʊ.ɚ ˈjɛ.loʊ dɪˈlɪ.və.ri trʌk baɪ lʌntʃ/

examples.en: Classical poems paint fierce infernal river fires guarded silently beside dark bronze gates.
examples.vi: Thơ ca cổ điển khắc họa dòng sông lửa chốn âm phủ rực cháy canh gác lặng lẽ bên cánh cổng đồng sẫm.
examples.ipaUs: /ˈklæ.sɪ.kəl ˈpoʊ.əmz peɪnt fɪrs ɪnˈfɝ.nəl ˈrɪ.vɚ faɪrz ˈɡɑr.dɪd ˈsaɪ.lənt.li bɪˈsaɪd dɑrk brɑnz ɡeɪts/

words.vi: bị nghiền bẹp dúm, xé rách tơi tả hoặc biến dạng méo mó (đồ vật hỏng, câu nói trích sai bét)
words.senseNote: Nhấn âm đầu /ˈmæŋ-/ với phụ âm mũi /ŋ/; miêu tả cả xe đạp bị bẹp và câu trích dẫn bị đọc sai hẳn nghĩa.

examples.en: A postal clerk rescued our soggy mangled birthday box safely after rainy truck sorting.
examples.vi: Nhân viên bưu điện đã kịp cứu chiếc hộp sinh nhật bị móp méo ẩm mưa của chúng tôi sau khâu phân loại.
examples.ipaUs: /ə ˈpoʊ.stəl klɝk ˈrɛ.skjud ˈaʊ.ɚ ˈsɑ.ɡi ˈmæŋ.ɡəld ˈbɝθ.ˌdeɪ bɑks ˈseɪf.li ˈæf.tɚ ˈreɪ.ni trʌk ˈsɔr.tɪŋ/

examples.en: Speech writers carefully fix any mangled foreign street names ahead of radio broadcasts.
examples.vi: Người biên soạn phát biểu sửa kỹ bất kỳ tên phố nước ngoài nào dễ bị đọc trẹo đi trước giờ lên sóng.
examples.ipaUs: /spitʃ ˈraɪ.tɚz ˈkɛr.fə.li fɪks ˈɛ.ni ˈmæŋ.ɡəld ˈfɔ.rən strit neɪmz əˈhɛd ʌv ˈreɪ.di.ˌoʊ ˈbrɔd.ˌkæsts/

words.vi: có khả năng xua đuổi, chống thấm đẩy nước hoặc gây cảm giác phản cảm khó chịu
words.senseNote: Nhấn âm hai /-ˈpɛ-/; tránh nhầm chính tả với chữ "e" ở đuôi (-lent), thường dùng trong water repellent hay insect repellent.

examples.en: Wear a water repellent windbreaker when hiking along misty mountain ridges in spring.
examples.vi: Hãy mặc áo khoác gió chống thấm nước khi đi bộ đường dài dọc sống núi đầy sương mùa xuân.
examples.ipaUs: /wɛr ə ˈwɔ.tɚ rɪˈpɛ.lənt ˈwɪnd.ˌbreɪ.kɚ wɛn ˈhaɪ.kɪŋ əˈlɔŋ ˈmɪ.sti ˈmaʊn.tən ˈrɪ.dʒɪz ɪn sprɪŋ/

examples.en: Critics found the villain’s cruel vanity utterly repellent throughout the final chapter.
examples.vi: Giới phê bình thấy tính tự phụ tàn nhẫn của nhân vật phản diện thực sự gây phản cảm xuyên suốt chương cuối.
examples.ipaUs: /ˈkrɪ.tɪks faʊnd ðə ˈvɪ.lənz ˈkru.əl ˈvæ.nə.ti ˈʌ.tɚ.li rɪˈpɛ.lənt θruˈaʊt ðə ˈfaɪ.nəl ˈtʃæp.tɚ/

words.vi: dư thừa, không cần thiết hoặc vượt quá mức hữu ích cần có
words.senseNote: Chú ý sửa lỗi nặng ở bản thô: phải nhấn âm tiết thứ hai /-ˈpɝ-/ và tách rõ /-flu.əs/ gồm hai nguyên âm riêng biệt.

examples.en: Good editors trim superfluous adjectives so every paragraph moves with crisp clarity.
examples.vi: Biên tập viên giỏi cắt bỏ những tính từ thừa thãi để mỗi đoạn văn đều sắc nét và súc tích.
examples.ipaUs: /ɡʊd ˈɛ.də.tɚz trɪm suˈpɝ.flu.əs ˈæ.dʒɪk.tɪvz soʊ ˈɛv.ri ˈpɛ.rə.ˌɡræf muvz wɪð krɪsp ˈklɛ.rə.ti/

examples.en: Adding a third paper receipt felt completely superfluous once the email confirmation arrived.
examples.vi: Việc in thêm tờ biên lai giấy thứ ba trở nên hoàn toàn thừa thãi khi thư xác nhận điện tử đã tới nơi.
examples.ipaUs: /ˈæ.dɪŋ ə θɝd ˈpeɪ.pɚ rɪˈsit fɛlt kəmˈplit.li suˈpɝ.flu.əs wʌns ði ˈi.ˌmeɪl ˌkɑn.fɚˈmeɪ.ʃən əˈraɪvd/

words.vi: khắc nghiệt, không chút nhân nhượng hoặc rất khó tha thứ lỗi lầm
words.senseNote: Trọng âm phụ ở đầu /ˌʌn-/, nhấn chính vào âm tiết thứ ba /-ˈɡɪ-/; dùng cho cả tính cách con người lẫn địa hình thời tiết.

examples.en: Icy mountain ridges remain unforgiving toward hikers who ignore early storm forecasts.
examples.vi: Những sườn núi băng giá luôn khắc nghiệt với người leo núi phớt lờ bản tin cảnh báo bão sớm.
examples.ipaUs: /ˈaɪ.si ˈmaʊn.tən ˈrɪ.dʒɪz rɪˈmeɪn ˌʌn.fɚˈɡɪ.vɪŋ tɔrd ˈhaɪ.kɚz hu ɪɡˈnɔr ˈɝ.li stɔrm ˈfɔr.ˌkæsts/

examples.en: Tight porcelain repairs leave zero room for error under unforgiving gallery spotlights.
examples.vi: Công việc phục chế đồ sứ tỉ mỉ không cho phép sai sót dưới ánh đèn rọi phòng trưng bày sắc lạnh.
examples.ipaUs: /taɪt ˈpɔr.sə.lən rɪˈpɛrz liv ˈzɪ.roʊ rum fɔr ˈɛ.rɚ ˈʌn.dɚ ˌʌn.fɚˈɡɪ.vɪŋ ˈɡæ.lɚ.i ˈspɑt.ˌlaɪts/

words.vi: thực sự, đích thực (dùng để nhấn mạnh tính chất ấn tượng như một ẩn dụ sống động)
words.senseNote: Nhấn âm đầu /ˈvɛ-/; luôn đứng trước danh từ để làm tăng sức biểu cảm (a veritable treasure trove).

examples.en: The upstairs spice cabinet held a veritable rainbow of dried peppers from three continents.
examples.vi: Tủ gia vị trên gác chứa cả một cầu vồng đích thực gồm đủ loại ớt khô từ ba châu lục.
examples.ipaUs: /ði ˌʌpˈstɛrz spaɪs ˈkæ.bə.nət hɛld ə ˈvɛ.rə.tə.bəl ˈreɪn.ˌboʊ ʌv draɪd ˈpɛ.pɚz frʌm θri ˈkɑn.tə.nənts/

examples.en: Botanical gardens turn into a veritable symphony of birdcalls right after May dawn.
examples.vi: Vườn bách thảo biến thành một bản giao hưởng tiếng chim thực thụ ngay sau bình minh tháng Năm.
examples.ipaUs: /bəˈtæ.nɪ.kəl ˈɡɑr.dənz tɝn ˈɪn.tu ə ˈvɛ.rə.tə.bəl ˈsɪm.fə.ni ʌv ˈbɝd.ˌkɔlz raɪt ˈæf.tɚ meɪ dɔn/

words.vi: cực kỳ thiết yếu, mang tính sống còn hoặc vô cùng quan trọng
words.senseNote: Nhấn âm đầu /ˈvaɪ-/; rất hay ghép cùng "important" thành cụm cố định "vitally important".

examples.en: Clear radio signals remain vitally important for rescue boats sailing through thick fog.
examples.vi: Tín hiệu vô tuyến rõ ràng vẫn cực kỳ sống còn đối với xuồng cứu hộ vượt màn sương dày.
examples.ipaUs: /klɪr ˈreɪ.di.ˌoʊ ˈsɪɡ.nəlz rɪˈmeɪn ˈvaɪ.tə.li ɪmˈpɔr.tənt fɔr ˈrɛ.skju boʊts ˈseɪ.lɪŋ θru θɪk fɑɡ/

examples.en: Drinking water regularly stays vitally necessary during long summer cycling tours.
examples.vi: Uống nước đều đặn luôn là điều thiết yếu trong suốt những chuyến đạp xe đường dài mùa hè.
examples.ipaUs: /ˈdrɪŋ.kɪŋ ˈwɔ.tɚ ˈrɛ.ɡjə.lɚ.li steɪz ˈvaɪ.tə.li ˈnɛ.sə.ˌsɛ.ri ˈdʊ.rɪŋ lɔŋ ˈsʌ.mɚ ˈsaɪ.klɪŋ tʊrz/

words.vi: tồi tệ thảm hại hết sức, cực kỳ kém cỏi (hoặc sâu thẳm không đáy trong địa chất)
words.senseNote: Nhấn âm hai /-ˈbɪz-/ với âm /z/ hữu thanh (cùng gốc danh từ abyss); hay dùng để chê chất lượng dịch vụ, thời tiết hay kết quả.

examples.en: Blurry night-game streams and abysmal audio frustrated fans watching at home.
examples.vi: Đường truyền trận đấu tối mờ nhòe cùng âm thanh thảm hại làm khán giả xem ở nhà bực bội.
examples.ipaUs: /ˈblɝ.i naɪt ɡeɪm strimz ænd əˈbɪz.məl ˈɔ.di.ˌoʊ ˈfrʌ.ˌstreɪ.təd fænz ˈwɑ.tʃɪŋ æt hoʊm/

examples.en: Poor drainage caused abysmal potato yields across the waterlogged valley this season.
examples.vi: Thoát nước kém khiến sản lượng khoai tây vụ này ở vùng thung lũng ngập úng thấp thảm hại.
examples.ipaUs: /pʊr ˈdreɪ.nədʒ kɔzd əˈbɪz.məl pəˈteɪ.toʊ jildz əˈkrɔs ðə ˈwɔ.tɚ.ˌlɔɡd ˈvæ.li ðɪs ˈsi.zən/

words.vi: trong trẻo, vang dội và đầy thúc giục rõ ràng (như tiếng kèn hiệu lệnh)
words.senseNote: Nhấn âm đầu /ˈklɛ-/; gần như luôn đi trong cụm tu từ nổi tiếng "a clarion call" (tiếng gọi thúc giục đầy rõ ràng).

examples.en: The young scientist delivered a clarion call for cleaner river standards nationwide.
examples.vi: Nhà khoa học trẻ đưa ra lời kêu gọi vang dội đầy rõ ràng về tiêu chuẩn sông ngòi sạch hơn trên toàn quốc.
examples.ipaUs: /ðə jʌŋ ˈsaɪ.ən.tɪst dɪˈlɪ.vɚd ə ˈklɛ.ri.ən kɔl fɔr ˈkli.nɚ ˈrɪ.vɚ ˈstæn.dɚdz ˌneɪ.ʃənˈwaɪd/

examples.en: Across the misty valley carried the clarion note of a brass horn greeting sunrise.
examples.vi: Vang vọng qua thung lũng sương mờ là âm thanh trong trẻo dõng dạc của chiếc tù và đồng chào đón bình minh.
examples.ipaUs: /əˈkrɔs ðə ˈmɪ.sti ˈvæ.li ˈkɛ.rid ðə ˈklɛ.ri.ən noʊt ʌv ə bræs hɔrn ˈɡri.tɪŋ ˈsʌn.ˌraɪz/

words.vi: hạ thấp giá trị, sỉ nhục hoặc làm tổn thương lòng tự trọng của người khác
words.senseNote: Nhấn âm hai /-ˈmi-/ với nguyên âm dài /i/; thường dùng miêu tả lời nhận xét hay thái độ đối xử thiếu tôn trọng.

examples.en: Fair workplace rules strictly ban demeaning jokes directed at junior interns.
examples.vi: Nội quy nơi làm việc công bằng nghiêm cấm tuyệt đối những câu đùa hạ thấp nhắm vào thực tập sinh trẻ.
examples.ipaUs: /fɛr ˈwɝk.ˌpleɪs rulz ˈstrɪkt.li bæn dɪˈmi.nɪŋ dʒoʊks dɚˈɛk.təd æt ˈdʒun.jɚ ˈɪn.ˌtɝnz/

examples.en: Parents objected to the demeaning tone used in the pamphlet toward community workers.
examples.vi: Phụ huynh phản đối giọng điệu hạ thấp dùng trong tờ rơi đối với người lao động cộng đồng.
examples.ipaUs: /ˈpɛ.rənts əbˈdʒɛk.təd tu ðə dɪˈmi.nɪŋ toʊn juzd ɪn ðə ˈpæm.flət tɔrd kəˈmju.nə.ti ˈwɝ.kɚz/

words.vi: xui xẻo, kém may mắn đáng thương (dù không làm gì sai vẫn gặp rắc rối liên tiếp)
words.senseNote: Nhấn âm đầu /ˈhæp-/; mang sắc thái cảm thông nhẹ nhàng hoặc hài hước hơn từ "unfortunate".

examples.en: Bystanders rushed to help the hapless commuter whose paper grocery bag split in the crosswalk.
examples.vi: Người qua đường vội chạy lại đỡ anh khách đi làm xui xẻo có túi giấy đựng thực phẩm rách toạc ngay vạch sang đường.
examples.ipaUs: /ˈbaɪ.ˌstæn.dɚz rʌʃt tu hɛlp ðə ˈhæp.ləs kəˈmju.tɚ huz ˈpeɪ.pɚ ˈɡroʊ.sɚ.i bæɡ splɪt ɪn ðə ˈkrɔs.ˌwɔk/

examples.en: Silent comedies often star a hapless waiter dodging swinging kitchen doors with tall trays.
examples.vi: Phim hài câm hay có vai anh bồi bàn xui xẻo né cửa bếp đung đưa trong lúc bưng khay cao ngất.
examples.ipaUs: /ˈsaɪ.lənt ˈkɑ.mə.diz ˈɔ.fən stɑr ə ˈhæp.ləs ˈweɪ.tɚ ˈdɑ.dʒɪŋ ˈswɪ.ŋɪŋ ˈkɪ.tʃən dɔrz wɪð tɔl treɪz/

words.vi: kinh khủng, khắc nghiệt dữ dội như địa ngục (chỉ thời tiết oi bức, giao thông tắc nghẽn hay công việc nặng)
words.senseNote: Nhấn âm đầu /ˈhɛ-/, hai chữ "l" giữ gọn như một âm /l/ chuyển sang đuôi /-ɪʃ/.

examples.en: Broken subway switches turned Monday’s evening ride home into a hellish three-hour crawl.
examples.vi: Lỗi ghi đường ray tàu điện ngầm biến chuyến về nhà tối thứ Hai thành cảnh nhích từng mét kinh khủng suốt ba giờ.
examples.ipaUs: /ˈbroʊ.kən ˈsʌb.ˌweɪ ˈswɪ.tʃɪz tɝnd ˈmʌn.ˌdeɪz ˈiv.nɪŋ raɪd hoʊm ˈɪn.tu ə ˈhɛ.lɪʃ θri ˈaʊ.ɚ krɔl/

examples.en: Desert road crews paused paving during hellish afternoon heatwaves topping forty-five degrees.
examples.vi: Đội làm đường sa mạc tạm ngưng trải nhựa giữa đợt nắng nóng khắc nghiệt buổi chiều vượt bốn mươi lăm độ.
examples.ipaUs: /ˈdɛ.zɚt roʊd kruz pɔzd ˈpeɪ.vɪŋ ˈdʊ.rɪŋ ˈhɛ.lɪʃ ˌæf.tɚˈnun ˈhit.ˌweɪvz ˈtɑ.pɪŋ ˈfɔr.ti faɪv dɪˈɡriz/

words.vi: trong phạm vi sức người có thể làm được (gần như luôn gắn với cụm "humanly possible")
words.senseNote: Nhấn âm đầu với bán nguyên âm /j/ rõ (/ˈhju-/), giữ ba âm tiết gọn nhẹ.

examples.en: Firefighters worked around the clock doing everything humanly possible to shield cedar homes.
examples.vi: Lính cứu hỏa làm việc suốt ngày đêm, làm mọi điều trong khả năng con người để che chắn những ngôi nhà gỗ tuyết tùng.
examples.ipaUs: /ˈfaɪr.ˌfaɪ.tɚz wɝkt əˈraʊnd ðə klɑk ˈdu.ɪŋ ˈɛv.ri.ˌθɪŋ ˈhju.mən.li ˈpɑ.sə.bəl tu ʃild ˈsi.dɚ hoʊmz/

examples.en: Translators double-checked every footnote so the manual stayed as clear as humanly possible.
examples.vi: Biên dịch viên soát lại từng chú thích để cuốn hướng dẫn đạt độ dễ hiểu tối đa trong sức người.
examples.ipaUs: /trænzˈleɪ.tɚz ˈdʌ.bəl tʃɛkt ˈɛv.ri ˈfʊt.ˌnoʊt soʊ ðə ˈmæn.ju.əl steɪd æz klɪr æz ˈhju.mən.li ˈpɑ.sə.bəl/

words.vi: hành vi hay quyết định ngu ngốc dại dột hết chỗ nói
words.senseNote: Nhấn âm đầu /ˈɪ-/, giữ bốn âm tiết ngắn nối mượt; là danh từ mang sắc thái chê trách mạnh.

examples.en: Park rangers called climbing past safety ropes near icy cliff edges sheer idiocy.
examples.vi: Kiểm lâm công viên gọi hành động trèo qua dây chắn an toàn gần mép vách đá đóng băng là sự dại dột tột độ.
examples.ipaUs: /pɑrk ˈreɪn.dʒɚz kɔld ˈklaɪ.mɪŋ pæst ˈseɪf.ti roʊps nɪr ˈaɪ.si klɪf ˈɛ.dʒɪz ʃɪr ˈɪ.di.ə.si/

examples.en: Critics ridiculed the idiocy of tearing down healthy shade trees beside sunny schoolyards.
examples.vi: Giới phê bình chỉ trích sự ngớ ngẩn của việc chặt bỏ những hàng cây bóng mát khỏe mạnh cạnh sân trường nắng.
examples.ipaUs: /ˈkrɪ.tɪks ˈrɪ.dɪ.ˌkjuld ði ˈɪ.di.ə.si ʌv ˈtɛ.rɪŋ daʊn ˈhɛl.θi ʃeɪd triz bɪˈsaɪd ˈsʌ.ni ˈskul.ˌjɑrdz/

words.vi: bị phóng đại quá mức, nói quá lên so với thực tế (hay gặp trong "easily overstated" hoặc "vastly overstated")
words.senseNote: Khi đứng trước danh từ thường nhấn chính âm đầu /ˈoʊ-/ và trọng âm phụ /-ˌsteɪ-/; khi đứng sau động từ liên kết đôi khi nhấn mạnh vào /-ˈsteɪ-/.

examples.en: Calm reviewers separated solid trial facts from overstated marketing slogans on the label.
examples.vi: Người đánh giá điềm tĩnh tách bạch số liệu thử nghiệm thực tế khỏi những khẩu hiệu quảng cáo nói quá trên nhãn hàng.
examples.ipaUs: /kɑm rɪˈvju.ɚz ˈsɛ.pə.ˌreɪ.təd ˈsɑ.ləd ˈtraɪ.əl fækts frʌm ˈoʊ.vɚ.ˌsteɪ.təd ˈmɑr.kə.tɪŋ ˈsloʊ.ɡənz ɑn ðə ˈleɪ.bəl/

examples.en: Early weather panic turned out vastly overstated once the rainstorm drifted north harmlessly.
examples.vi: Nỗi lo bão sớm hóa ra bị thổi phồng quá mức khi cơn mưa bão trôi vô hại lên phía bắc.
examples.ipaUs: /ˈɝ.li ˈwɛ.ðɚ ˈpæ.nɪk tɝnd aʊt ˈvæst.li ˈoʊ.vɚ.ˌsteɪ.təd wʌns ðə ˈreɪn.ˌstɔrm ˈdrɪf.təd nɔrθ ˈhɑrm.ləs.li/

words.vi: bừa bãi thiếu chọn lọc; trong sinh học và mạng máy tính chỉ cơ chế tiếp nhận đa dạng nhiều tín hiệu không hạn chế
words.senseNote: Chú ý sửa trọng âm sai nghiêm trọng ở bản thô (/ˈpɹoʊmɪskwəs/): phải đọc nhẹ âm đầu /prə-/ và nhấn mạnh vào âm tiết thứ hai /-ˈmɪ-/.

examples.en: Network engineers turn on promiscuous port mode temporarily to inspect dropped packets.
examples.vi: Kỹ sư mạng tạm bật chế độ lắng nghe mở trên cổng mạng để kiểm tra các gói tin bị thất lạc.
examples.ipaUs: /ˈnɛt.ˌwɝk ˌɛn.dʒəˈnɪrz tɝn ɑn prəˈmɪ.skju.əs pɔrt moʊd ˌtɛm.pəˈrɛ.rə.li tu ɪnˈspɛkt drɑpt ˈpæ.kəts/

examples.en: Biochemistry papers describe promiscuous enzymes capable of binding multiple plant sugars safely.
examples.vi: Các bài báo hóa sinh mô tả những enzyme đa năng có thể gắn kết an toàn với nhiều loại đường thực vật khác nhau.
examples.ipaUs: /ˌbaɪ.oʊˈkɛ.mə.stri ˈpeɪ.pɚz dɪˈskraɪb prəˈmɪ.skju.əs ˈɛn.ˌzaɪmz ˈkeɪ.pə.bəl ʌv ˈbaɪn.dɪŋ ˈmʌl.tə.pəl plænt ˈʃʊ.ɡɚz ˈseɪf.li/

words.vi: sự gian ác, thói xấu xa tàn nhẫn; đôi khi mang nghĩa tinh quái nghịch ngợm trong văn chương
words.senseNote: Nhấn âm đầu /ˈwɪ-/, chú ý giữ đủ âm tiết thứ hai /-kəd-/ theo tính từ gốc "wicked" chứ không nuốt mất.

examples.en: Classic fairy tales teach young listeners how everyday kindness outlasts selfish wickedness.
examples.vi: Truyện cổ tích kinh điển dạy các em nhỏ thấy lòng tốt bình dị luôn bền lâu hơn thói xấu ích kỷ.
examples.ipaUs: /ˈklæ.sɪk ˈfɛ.ri teɪlz titʃ jʌŋ ˈlɪ.sə.nɚz haʊ ˈɛv.ri.ˌdeɪ ˈkaɪnd.nəs ˌaʊtˈlæsts ˈsɛl.fɪʃ ˈwɪ.kəd.nəs/

examples.en: A gleam of playful wickedness lit Grandpa’s eyes right before he hid the last cookie jar.
examples.vi: Ánh nhìn tinh nghịch ranh mãnh thoáng qua mắt ông nội ngay trước khi ông giấu nốt lọ bánh quy cuối cùng.
examples.ipaUs: /ə ɡlim ʌv ˈpleɪ.fəl ˈwɪ.kəd.nəs lɪt ˈɡrænd.ˌpɑz aɪz raɪt bɪˈfɔr hi hɪd ðə læst ˈkʊ.ki dʒɑr/

words.vi: một cách đáng ngưỡng mộ, xuất sắc và khéo léo vượt mong đợi
words.senseNote: Nhấn âm đầu /ˈæd-/ (giống tính từ "admirable" chứ không nhấn âm hai như động từ "admire"!).

examples.en: Our substitute goalie performed admirably despite stepping onto wet turf with zero warm-up.
examples.vi: Thủ môn dự bị đã thi đấu xuất sắc đáng nể dù phải vào sân cỏ ướt mà chưa kịp khởi động.
examples.ipaUs: /ˈaʊ.ɚ ˈsʌb.stə.ˌtut ˈɡoʊ.li pɚˈfɔrmd ˈæd.mɚ.ə.bli dɪˈspaɪt ˈstɛ.pɪŋ ˈɑn.tu wɛt tɝf wɪð ˈzɪ.roʊ ˈwɔr.mʌp/

examples.en: Older canvas backpacks held up admirably across three rainy hiking trips without split seams.
examples.vi: Chiếc ba lô vải bố cũ bền bỉ đáng kinh ngạc qua ba chuyến đi bộ đường dài dưới mưa mà chẳng bung chỉ.
examples.ipaUs: /ˈoʊl.dɚ ˈkæn.vəs ˈbæk.ˌpæks hɛld ʌp ˈæd.mɚ.ə.bli əˈkrɔs θri ˈreɪ.ni ˈhaɪ.kɪŋ trɪps wɪˈðaʊt splɪt simz/

words.vi: tính ngắn gọn súc tích, cô đọng đúng trọng tâm trong lời phát biểu hoặc văn bản
words.senseNote: Nhấn âm đầu đọc ngắn /ˈbrɛ-/ (chú ý khác nguyên âm dài của tính từ "brief"!), ba âm tiết rõ ràng.

examples.en: Busy readers appreciate crisp brevity and clear bullet points in Friday morning project updates.
examples.vi: Người đọc bận rộn đánh giá cao sự súc tích ngắn gọn và gạch đầu dòng rõ ràng trong bản tin dự án sáng thứ Sáu.
examples.ipaUs: /ˈbɪ.zi ˈri.dɚz əˈpri.ʃi.ˌeɪt krɪsp ˈbrɛ.və.ti ænd klɪr ˈbʊ.lət pɔɪnts ɪn ˈfraɪ.ˌdeɪ ˈmɔr.nɪŋ ˈprɑ.dʒɛkt ˈʌp.ˌdeɪts/

examples.en: Theater teachers often quote Shakespeare’s remark praising brevity as the lively soul of wit.
examples.vi: Giáo viên kịch nghệ hay trích câu nói nổi tiếng của Shakespeare ca ngợi sự súc tích là linh hồn của trí tuệ dí dỏm.
examples.ipaUs: /ˈθi.ə.tɚ ˈti.tʃɚz ˈɔ.fən kwoʊt ˈʃeɪk.ˌspɪrz rɪˈmɑrk ˈpreɪ.zɪŋ ˈbrɛ.və.ti æz ðə ˈlaɪv.li soʊl ʌv wɪt/

words.vi: sự suy đồi băng hoại nghiêm trọng về mặt đạo đức hoặc phẩm giá con người

examples.en: Victorian novels contrasted quiet village generosity sharply against greedy urban depravity.
examples.vi: Tiểu thuyết thời Victoria đối chiếu sắc nét lòng hào phóng mộc mạc nơi làng quê với thói tha hóa tham lam chốn đô thị.

examples.en: Court records condemned the deliberate depravity of cheating elderly pensioners out of savings.
examples.vi: Hồ sơ tòa án lên án hành vi đồi bại có chủ ý khi lừa đảo lấy tiền tiết kiệm của các cụ già hưu trí.
examples.ipaUs: /kɔrt ˈrɛ.kɚdz kənˈdɛmd ðə dɪˈlɪ.bɚ.ət dɪˈpræ.və.ti ʌv ˈtʃi.tɪŋ ˈɛl.dɚ.li ˈpɛn.ʃə.nɚz aʊt ʌv ˈseɪ.vɪŋz/

words.vi: đi lạc hướng trệch mục tiêu (cú ném, đường bóng) hoặc cư xử sai quy chuẩn cần chấn chỉnh
words.senseNote: Nhấn âm đầu đọc là /ˈɛ-/ (cùng gốc động từ "err" — phạm sai lầm, lầm đường).

examples.en: An errant golf tee shot bounced sharply off a pine trunk back onto the green grass.
examples.vi: Cú phát bóng golf đi lệch hướng nảy mạnh khỏi thân cây thông rồi rơi ngược lại lên bãi cỏ.

examples.en: Sheepdogs dashed smoothly across the meadow to guide two errant lambs back into the flock.
examples.vi: Chó chăn cừu phóng nhanh qua đồng cỏ để lùa hai chú cừu non đi lạc quay về đàn.
examples.ipaUs: /ˈʃip.ˌdɔɡz dæʃt ˈsmuð.li əˈkrɔs ðə ˈmɛ.doʊ tu ɡaɪd tu ˈɛ.rənt læmz bæk ˈɪn.tu ðə flɑk/

words.vi: một cách tinh xảo tuyệt mỹ, cực kỳ khéo léo và trang nhã đến từng chi tiết nhỏ
words.senseNote: Chú ý bỏ trọng âm phụ thừa ở bản thô (/ˌɛkˈskwɪzɪtli/) và tách đúng cụm phụ âm /-skw-/: nhấn âm hai /-ˈskwɪ-/ (một số người nhấn đầu /ˈɛk.skwɪ.zət.li/).

examples.en: Artisans presented exquisitely painted lacquer trays shimmering softly beside museum glass lamps.
examples.vi: Nghệ nhân trưng bày những khay sơn mài vẽ tay tinh xảo óng ánh dịu dàng bên cạnh đèn kính bảo tàng.
examples.ipaUs: /ˈɑr.tə.zənz prɪˈzɛn.təd ɛkˈskwɪ.zət.li ˈpeɪn.təd ˈlæ.kɚ treɪz ˈʃɪ.mɚ.ɪŋ ˈsɔft.li bɪˈsaɪd mjuˈzi.əm ɡlæs læmps/

examples.en: Our tea host brewed pale spring oolong leaves to produce an exquisitely fragrant amber cup.
examples.vi: Chủ quán trà hãm lá ô long xuân non tạo nên tách trà màu hổ phách thơm thanh tao tuyệt hảo.
examples.ipaUs: /ˈaʊ.ɚ ti hoʊst brud peɪl sprɪŋ ˈu.ˌlɔŋ livz tu prəˈdus æn ɛkˈskwɪ.zət.li ˈfreɪ.ɡrənt ˈæm.bɚ kʌp/

words.vi: một cách hoàn hảo tuyệt đối, trơn tru không chút sai sót hay vết xước nào
words.senseNote: Nhấn âm đầu /ˈflɔ-/ (hoặc /ˈflɑ-/ ở một số vùng Mỹ), giữ nguyên âm schwa /-ləs-/ trước /-li/.

examples.en: Our backup generator started flawlessly within three seconds during Sunday’s storm outage.
examples.vi: Máy phát điện dự phòng khởi động trơn tru không lỗi lầm chỉ trong ba giây giữa sự cố mất điện do bão Chủ nhật.
examples.ipaUs: /ˈaʊ.ɚ ˈbæ.ˌkʌp ˈdʒɛ.nə.ˌreɪ.tɚ ˈstɑr.təd ˈflɔ.ləs.li wɪˈðɪn θri ˈsɛ.kəndz ˈdʊ.rɪŋ ˈsʌn.ˌdeɪz stɔrm ˈaʊ.tədʒ/

examples.en: All eight violinists executed the rapid bowing passage flawlessly under bright concert lights.
examples.vi: Cả tám nghệ sĩ vĩ cầm kéo trọn đoạn vĩ tốc độ cao hoàn hảo không chệch một nốt dưới ánh đèn hòa nhạc rực rỡ.
examples.ipaUs: /ɔl eɪt ˌvaɪ.əˈlɪ.nɪsts ˈɛk.sə.ˌkju.təd ðə ˈræ.pəd ˈboʊ.ɪŋ ˈpæ.sɪdʒ ˈflɔ.ləs.li ˈʌn.dɚ braɪt ˈkɑn.sɚt laɪts/

words.vi: loại người, nhóm người hoặc thứ đồ cùng kiểu loại tương đồng ("of that ilk")
words.senseNote: Một âm tiết gọn /ɪlk/; luôn dùng số ít kèm giới từ "of" (people of his ilk), thường mang sắc thái bình luận trang trọng hoặc hơi châm biếm.

examples.en: Book reviewers grouped gentle travel writers of that quiet observational ilk together cheerfully.
examples.vi: Giới điểm sách vui vẻ xếp các nhà văn du ký nhẹ nhàng thuộc nhóm quan sát trầm lắng ấy chung một kệ.
examples.ipaUs: /bʊk rɪˈvju.ɚz ɡrupt ˈdʒɛn.təl ˈtræ.vəl ˈraɪ.tɚz ʌv ðæt ˈkwaɪ.ət ˌɑb.zɚˈveɪ.ʃə.nəl ɪlk təˈɡɛ.ðɚ ˈtʃɪr.fə.li/

examples.en: Practical savers tend to avoid quick-profit schemes and flashy brochures of that noisy ilk.
examples.vi: Người tiết kiệm thực tế thường tránh những dự án hứa hẹn lời nhanh và tờ rơi bóng bẩy thuộc kiểu phô trương ấy.
examples.ipaUs: /ˈpræk.tə.kəl ˈseɪ.vɚz tɛnd tu əˈvɔɪd kwɪk ˈprɑ.fət skimz ænd ˈflæ.ʃi broʊˈʃʊrz ʌv ðæt ˈnɔɪ.zi ɪlk/

words.vi: hành động điên rồ, liều lĩnh thiếu suy nghĩ đến mức khó tin (thường dùng nhấn mạnh phản đối ý tưởng dại dột)
words.senseNote: Nhấn âm đầu với nguyên âm dài /ˈlu-/, hai âm cuối nhẹ nhàng /-nə.si/.

examples.en: Experienced sailors called crossing winter shoals without radar utter lunacy.
examples.vi: Thủy thủ dày dạn gọi việc băng qua bãi cạn mùa đông mà không có ra-đa là sự liều lĩnh điên rồ.
examples.ipaUs: /ɪkˈspɪ.ri.ənst ˈseɪ.lɚz kɔld ˈkrɔ.sɪŋ ˈwɪn.tɚ ʃoʊlz wɪˈðaʊt ˈreɪ.ˌdɑr ˈʌ.tɚ ˈlu.nə.si/

examples.en: Tearing down a sunlit community greenhouse for three extra parking spots felt like pure lunacy.
examples.vi: Phá bỏ nhà kính cộng đồng chan hòa nắng chỉ để thêm ba chỗ đỗ xe quả là chuyện điên rồ thực sự.
examples.ipaUs: /ˈtɛ.rɪŋ daʊn ə ˈsʌn.ˌlɪt kəˈmju.nə.ti ˈɡrin.ˌhaʊs fɔr θri ˈɛk.strə ˈpɑr.kɪŋ spɑts fɛlt laɪk pjʊr ˈlu.nə.si/

words.vi: một cách không thương tiếc, khắc nghiệt
words.senseNote: Miêu tả hành động chỉ trích, tấn công hoặc thời tiết khắc nghiệt không chút nương tay.

examples.en: Film critics mocked the sloppy sequel mercilessly in weekend newspaper columns.
examples.vi: Giới phê bình phim chế giễu phần hậu truyện cẩu thả không thương tiếc trên mục báo cuối tuần.
examples.ipaUs: /fɪlm ˈkrɪtɪks mɑkt ðə ˈslɑpi ˈsikwəl ˈmɝsələsli ɪn ˈwikˌɛnd ˈnuzˌpeɪpɚ ˈkɑləmz/

examples.en: Desert sun beat down mercilessly across unshaded canyon trails by noon.
examples.vi: Nắng sa mạc thiêu đốt khắc nghiệt xuống các lối mòn hẻm núi không bóng râm vào buổi trưa.

passages.title: Restoring the Mountain Valley Orchard
passages.text: Last autumn, volunteers from our farming cooperative gathered to restore an ancient citrus orchard nestled beneath the highlands. At sunrise, the weather was exceptionally fine, with clear blue skies spreading over the surrounding valleys. However, past neglect and sudden frost had forced several old fruit trees to shed their branches prematurely. Local agricultural advisers recommended tried and tested cultivation techniques to nurse the damaged roots back to life. Hand-dug irrigation ditches ensured that abundant fresh stream water remained constantly available to every terrace. Working on steep slopes under the midday sun proved to be a wearing task for the younger volunteers. Yet, everyone collaborated well, taking short fifteen-minute pauses under the shade of evergreen pines. A telling sign of early recovery appeared within two weeks, when fragile green shoots sprouted from dry bark. Seeing these positive results brought a certain quiet confidence to the entire gardening team. By late afternoon on the tenth day, the community had finished pruning dead timber and spreading organic mulch. Thanks to increased rainfall and careful soil aeration, the orchard began flourishing with renewed vigor. Local farmers felt certain that patient dedication and ecological stewardship would yield abundant harvests in coming seasons. When neighbors combine tested knowledge with cheerful mutual labor, even neglected lands blossom into bountiful gardens. The fragrance of blossoming blossoms filled the air, creating a serene sanctuary that inspires villagers of all ages. Visitors who travel along the valley road frequently stop to admire the magnificent emerald rows of thriving trees. This shared triumph demonstrates the enduring power of community harmony and natural respect.

passages.title: The Artisan's Workshop Renovation
passages.text: In an old quarter of town stood a quiet studio that seemed ideal for creative woodwork. When Master Nolan first arrived, the workshop looked terrible because of damp walls and years of neglect. A broken workbench rested against the rear wall, surrounded by piles of discarded timber. He began by inspecting the room carefully to describe every necessary repair on a blank notepad. Several window frames were fitted with strange glass panels that rattled loudly in the chilly wind. The weather was freezing outside, so Nolan wore a thick woolen sweater and durable work gloves. Some storage corners felt very tight to move around, but he organized each section with patience. He replaced the cracked wooden boards with thin, lightweight oak sheets to build sturdy shelves. A local apprentice arrived each morning to help sand the surfaces and organize the hand tools. Visitors who stepped inside watched the gradual transformation and found his traditional craftsmanship truly interesting. They praised the fine details of the restored cabinets and asked questions about classic woodworking techniques. With steady effort and excellent dedication, the dusty room turned into a lovely creative space. By the third week, warm sunlight streamed across the polished tables, creating a wonderful environment for making furniture. Neighborhood families came to visit on weekends, marveling at the remarkable change in the historic building. Nolan smiled proudly at the finished studio, knowing that hard work can revive even the most challenging space. The bright and spacious workshop now serves as an inspiring gathering place where aspiring young woodworkers learn traditional skills with confidence.

passages.title: The Annual Young Inventors Showcase
passages.titleVi: Hội chợ triển lãm các nhà sáng chế trẻ thường niên
passages.text: Yesterday afternoon, the university exhibition hall buzzed with energy as dozens of creative student teams presented their mechanical inventions. The annual showcase was evaluated by a panel of judges led by a celebrated engineering mentor renowned for her solar energy designs. Moving slowly down the aisles with a searching gaze, the judges inspected the intricate technical contents of each prototype. One outstanding exhibit featured a solar water purification system built to withstand harsh weather conditions in remote deserts. Its control console displayed bright colored indicator lights that signaled clean water flow in real time. The judges noted that this affordable innovation could have far-reaching practical impacts on public health in drought-affected villages. Throughout the hall, enthusiastic spectators gathered around the arena, screaming with excitement as student robotics prototypes competed in agility trials. During her keynote address, the chief engineer emphasized that technological curiosity opens up infinite creative possibilities for young designers. When the evaluation committee announced the final competition ranking, the solar purification team was awarded the championship trophy in the top project tier. The celebratory applause from teammates, parents, and professors reflected profound pride in what youthful ingenuity can achieve. Events like this prove that when passion and rigorous engineering unite, innovative student concepts transform into life-changing solutions that serve the wider global community. Walking through the vibrant exhibition floor, visitors felt genuinely uplifted by the sheer dedication of the young participants. Many industry representatives exchanged contact information with students, offering internships and mentorship opportunities. These enduring connections ensure that inspiring scientific ideas receive the resources needed to flourish into real-world applications.

passages.title: Preserving Architectural Heritage and Embracing Modern Design
passages.text: Urban renewal requires a delicate balance between preserving classic historical architecture and constructing modern facilities that serve growing populations. Last autumn, our municipal heritage committee launched an engaging public exhibition showcasing regional design traditions. The centerpiece of the gallery was an iconic stone clock tower built two centuries ago, whose timeless elegance remained fully intact. Curators displayed sealed glass display cases containing antique blueprints, rare photographs, and preserved architectural sketches. During the opening presentation, a leading historian explained how brutal winter freezes had damaged old masonry walls, causing structural cracks to grow steadily worse each decade. Without urgent intervention, the monument faced the worst deterioration in its history. Fortunately, city planners made a quick and decisive intervention, conducting thorough structural assessments to reverse the damaging effect of seasonal moisture. The deciding factor in selecting the restoration proposal was its commitment to using authentic local limestone and sustainable mortar. In the newly renovated pavilion adjacent to the tower, visitors enjoyed a fitting celebration featuring fresh regional appetizers and live instrumental music. The harmonious blend of classic craftsmanship and modern engineering proved that historic landmarks can flourish alongside innovative civic spaces. Furthermore, local school groups toured the restored halls, where enthusiastic students asked insightful questions about engineering techniques. Understanding the durability of heritage materials encourages young people to cherish civic landmarks and appreciate architectural beauty. Such collaborative municipal projects demonstrate that honoring the past while embracing progress creates vibrant, resilient cities. Walking through the sunlit plaza, citizens admired the breathtaking interplay of ancient stone and contemporary glass. Visitors left the exhibition feeling deeply inspired by how thoughtful architecture enriches daily neighborhood life.

passages.title: Building Sustainable Innovations in Community Workshops
passages.titleVi: Xây dựng các sáng kiến bền vững tại xưởng chế tạo cộng đồng
passages.text: In an energetic neighborhood workshop, creative inventors and enthusiastic students gather daily to design environmentally friendly technologies. Several months ago, early prototypes constructed by beginners performed poorly during outdoor stress tests, producing pathetic efficiency rates that discouraged initial investors. Rather than giving up, the head instructor emphasized that mastering proper engineering methods requires patience and consistent practice. He demonstrated how following specific wiring diagrams and selecting durable recycled components transforms fragile gadgets into remarkably useful tools. To spark creativity, senior mentors shared a secret technique for balancing battery cells safely without generating excess heat. Within weeks, the team achieved a promising breakthrough by constructing a powerful solar-assisted water purifier designed for remote villages. The device made a profound impact on local health initiatives, providing clean drinking water to hundreds of surrounding households. As news of the initiative spread across town, the educational makerspace quickly grew into a highly popular meeting hub for aspiring innovators of all ages. The radiant enthusiasm of the students was reflected in the vibrant gallery displays showcasing their completed prototypes. Local business owners visited the facility regularly, offering financial grants and mentorship to ensure each project adhered to strict industrial standards. By combining hands-on technical skills with responsible ecological stewardship, the workshop proved that dedication turns rough beginnings into celebrated achievements. Visitors walked through the sunlit testing yard feeling inspired by the ingenuity on display. This collaborative space reminds us that when communities invest in youthful curiosity, practical solutions flourish to benefit society as a whole. Working together across generations creates lasting bonds and empowers people to overcome complex modern environmental hurdles.

passages.title: Transforming the Historic Mountain Trail
passages.titleVi: Cải tạo con đường mòn leo núi lịch sử
passages.text: Maintaining scenic mountain trails requires disciplined community collaboration, careful planning, and persistent physical effort. Last autumn, heavy rainstorms swept across the valley, leaving our historic pine ridge path badly damaged by mudslides. Trail conditions were awful, with deep fallen boulders blocking access and making safe hiking virtually impossible for visiting families. Local park rangers realized that repairing the path had become an extremely pressing issue before the arrival of winter frost. At first, the municipal park budget was lacking sufficient funding, leaving rangers worried about safety. The restoration team relied mainly on dedicated neighborhood volunteers who gathered early every weekend morning. Inspecting every single detail along the slopes, experienced builders drew up a thorough structural renovation plan. Because it had rained heavily for weeks, volunteers could hardly push wheelbarrows across the slick clay soil. Nevertheless, team leaders obtained the necessary timber supports and gravel bags to reinforce unstable cliff edges. Working diligently under crisp autumn sunshine, volunteers rebuilt sturdy wooden guardrails with enhanced stability. By late November, the once-dangerous trail had undergone a fantastic transformation into a secure, scenic pathway. Hikers admired the smooth walking surfaces, panoramic viewing decks, and informative botanical markers lining the route. This collective achievement demonstrated that community determination turns challenging situations into lasting public treasures. Today, families explore the lush forest safely, deeply grateful to the thoughtful volunteers whose hard work revitalized the natural landscape. When neighbors unite to care for shared public spaces, everyone benefits from cleaner air, safer recreation, and renewed civic pride.

passages.title: The Riverside Community Garden Transformation
passages.titleVi: Sự chuyển mình của khu vườn cộng đồng ven sông
passages.text: Last spring, our town embarked on an ambitious project to revitalize an abandoned riverbank into an attractive community garden. At first, the overgrown area presented a seemingly chaotic situation, with rusted wire fences and wild weeds affecting the shoreline ecology. Local residents felt deeply that creating an accessible public park would bring a significant improvement to daily neighborhood life. Environmental organizers held informative weekly meetings to establish an appropriate landscape design that honored the town's agricultural background. Municipal planners published a detailed written description outlining how native shade trees, stone pathways, and flowerbeds would replace discarded debris. In striking contrast to the neglected past, enthusiastic volunteers arrived every weekend to dig compost trenches and install sturdy timber benches. Tasks were organized efficiently so that preparing each flowerbed took two hours tops. Clean water pumped from an adjacent freshwater reservoir provided irrigation comparable to high-tech botanical nursery systems. Soon, this remarkable collaborative effort became widely recognized across neighboring districts as an inspiring model of civic cooperation. The arrival of sunny summer mornings marked the eagerly anticipated opening day of the riverfront promenade. Families admired the vibrant blossoms set against the scenic mountain background, praising every contributing volunteer who dedicated time and energy. Children learned about organic vegetable gardening, while elderly neighbors enjoyed peaceful morning strolls along shaded brick pathways. Transforming a neglected riverbank into an attractive green haven proved that collective action turns a difficult situation into enduring community pride. When people share genuine respect for nature and work diligently together, the positive benefits are deeply felt for future generations.

passages.title: Discovering Hidden Treasures at the Heritage Flea Market
passages.titleVi: Khám phá kho báu tiềm ẩn tại chợ đồ cũ di sản
passages.text: Every Saturday morning, our town square hosts a vibrant antique and craft market where collectors search for unique treasures. Yesterday, college student Daniel visited the bustling stalls looking for suitable furnishings for his modest apartment. Rather than buying fancy commercial decorations, he preferred vintage items with distinctive historical charm. While browsing through a fairly crowded corner, Daniel stopped before an intriguing collection of wooden decor managed by an elderly craftsman. The artisan emphasized the historical importance of handcrafted objects, explaining how handmade goods withstand decades of use. Suddenly, a sudden gust of wind blew across the square, knocking a carved wooden box off the merchant's display table. Daniel caught the falling box with an instant reflex, ensuring the fragile object remained completely alright without any cracks. Examining the recovered treasure, Daniel was astonished to discover that the carved cedar lid was perfectly smooth to the touch, polished by years of gentle care. The craftsman noted that the delicate carving had been crafted by a talented but largely unknown rural woodcarver from a secluded mountain village. He assured Daniel that the chest was an authentic cultural artifact, bearing original floral motifs carved by hand. Seeing Daniel's genuine appreciation, the craftsman offered him a generous discount, making the price accessible for a student budget. Daniel carried the chest home proudly, thrilled to own a piece of living history. Experiences like this remind us that authentic beauty often lies in quiet craftsmanship rather than extravagant luxury. When people value traditional heritage, old objects find loving homes where their timeless stories continue to shine for generations.

passages.title: Adapting to Environmental Changes in the River Basin
passages.titleVi: Thích ứng với Những Thay đổi Môi trường ở Lưu vực Dòng sông
passages.text: For centuries, our scenic river basin was a peaceful agricultural valley where generations of hardworking farmers cultivated fertile vegetable fields along winding waterways. However, recent erratic weather patterns have brought unusual climatic shifts to the entire highland region. Last winter, a savage mountain storm damaged several ancient stone embankments, revealing that natural ecosystems are never static or completely permanent. An enormous volume of rushing floodwater poured across low-lying meadows, demonstrating how quickly local environmental conditions can change without warning. In response, town planners observed an altered riverbank profile and promptly designed modern, sustainable flood-control barriers. Civil engineers constructed an artificial reservoir connected to surrounding diversion canals, which provided an exceptionally convenient system to regulate seasonal water flow safely and effectively. Environmental scientists noted a pronounced improvement in soil stability and water purity soon after the wetland restoration project was completed. They explained to concerned residents that severe river erosion was often a direct consequence of unmanaged deforestation along upper mountain slopes. To protect the watershed over the long term, the community replaced degraded pastures with native willow trees, deep-rooted shrubs, and protective wetland grasses. Local residents discovered that working alongside natural rhythms is far more sustainable than imposing rigid concrete walls on delicate river ecosystems. Today, the restored riverbank proudly welcomes flocks of returning migratory birds, creating a thriving natural sanctuary where school children learn environmental stewardship. Families enjoy walking along the convenient riverside paths on sunny weekends, admiring blooming water lilies and clear currents. By understanding ecological balance and adapting thoughtfully to natural forces, our community preserves a vibrant, healthy landscape for generations to come.

passages.title: The Artisan Studio at Twilight
passages.titleVi: Xưởng Thủ công Mỹ nghệ lúc Hoàng hôn
passages.text: Deep in the tranquil hill country, an old wooden workshop stands surrounded by ancient pine trees. Inside this fascinating studio, an experienced glassblower creates exquisite decorative ornaments using traditional techniques passed down through generations. Outside the tall workshop windows, the evening sky gradually transitioned into a warm amber glow that illuminated every corner of the workbench. A stark contrast existed between the cool darkness of the surrounding forest and the radiant heat pulsating from the brick kiln. The master craftsman worked quietly, focusing entirely on shaping molten crystal with practiced, precise hand movements. Every piece required flowing curves and smooth edges, demanding utmost patience so that unnecessary air bubbles were eliminated. Watching glowing liquid transform into solid vases was an inspiring experience for visiting apprentices who studied his craft. Each glass vessel featured delicate swirls of mysterious blues and greens that matched perfectly with handcrafted ceramic display plates. To prevent flaws, the artisan removed any unnecessary debris from the cooling chamber before placing each finished vase inside. Even when midnight approached, the master continued polishing each curve until it gleamed like a captured star. The apprentice observed how steady concentration turned simple sand and minerals into breathtaking works of lasting beauty. When craftsmen blend rigorous technical discipline with heartfelt creativity, everyday materials become timeless treasures. Visitors who explore the studio leave with deep appreciation for artistic dedication and harmonious visual expression. In an age dominated by hurried manufacturing, handcrafted beauty reminds us that patient craftsmanship enriches human culture in enduring ways.

passages.title: Restoring the Heart of the Heritage Marketplace
passages.titleVi: Phục hồi trái tim của khu chợ di sản
passages.text: Every Saturday morning, our historic riverside village gathers for a lively cultural festival centered on local heritage preservation. In the heart of town stood an old brick marketplace with distinctive arched windows and timber roofs that had sheltered vendors for over a century. Although heavy winter storms had left several exterior walls cracked and weathered, the foundational stone pillars remained completely intact. Community leaders presented a compelling proposal showing how restoring the historic pavilion would benefit modern residents while preserving timeless architectural charm. Local carpenters worked diligently with remarkable consistency, carefully repairing wooden trusses so that the main building became fully functioning once again. New brick pathways were paved around the perimeter, providing smooth convenience for elderly shoppers and parents pushing baby strollers. When the town mayor arrived to inspect the finished pavilion, brass trumpeters played loudly to welcome cheerful visitors. Inside the bustling hall, local farmers arranged colorful stalls displaying artisanal cheeses, crisp apples, and distinctive wildflower honey. Families strolled contentedly along the sunny boardwalk, sampling fresh warm pastries and listening to folk ballads. In the adjoining garden, schoolchildren planted fragrant lavender bushes that will bloom each spring. Neighbors laughed and conversed with spirited enthusiasm, celebrating how collective effort revived their beloved community meeting place. Organizers highlighted that preserving heritage structures does not mean halting progress, but rather weaving cherished traditions into daily civic life. As twilight fell across the cobblestone square, festive string lights cast a warm amber glow over the laughing crowd. This successful restoration proved that when citizens unite behind a shared vision, historic landmarks continue inspiring future generations for decades to come.

passages.title: The Master Jeweler and the Art of Precision
passages.titleVi: Người thợ kim hoàn bậc thầy và nghệ thuật của sự chuẩn xác
passages.text: In the heart of an old artisan district, master jeweler Arthur operated a quiet studio dedicated to handcrafted elegance. Every morning, the crisp autumn sunshine poured through tall windows, illuminating rows of delicate steel tools and shimmering gemstone trays. Arthur approached every custom commission with concentrated focus, believing that relentless dedication transforms raw minerals into timeless perfection. On his sturdy wooden workbench, he arranged stones of varying sizes and colors, selecting sapphire crystals with an especially appealing azure hue. To protect precious heirlooms from daily wear, he chose platinum alloys that were highly resistant to corrosion and scratches. Using miniature files, Arthur carved smooth rounded edges around each ring band so that it sat comfortably on the wearer's hand. He decorated the crown with tiny silver filigree leaves, creating a shining halo that reflected candlelight brilliantly. An apprentice watched Arthur's meticulous hand movements, learning that precision was the defining principle of classical goldsmithing. Before setting the centerpiece sapphire, Arthur gave explicit instructions regarding the delicate balance of pressure needed to secure the claws without cracking the crystal. He explicitly warned the student that rushing any step would compromise the symmetry of the entire setting. When the engagement ring was finally polished, its gleaming facets caught every angle of daylight with breathtaking brilliance. The grateful couple arrived that afternoon, admiring the exquisite ornament that symbolized their enduring devotion. Arthur smiled warmly, knowing that genuine artisanal mastery endures far beyond fleeting fashion trends. Such dedicated craftsmanship reminds us that patience and artistic discipline elevate simple materials into cherished works of art. Through meticulous care and unwavering integrity, traditional jewelers preserve heritage techniques that inspire awe across generations.

passages.title: Acoustic Restoration at the Seaside Concert Hall
passages.titleVi: Phục hồi âm học tại nhà hát hòa nhạc ven biển
passages.text: Nestled along a wind-swept coastline, our municipal concert hall is renowned worldwide for its majestic neoclassical architecture and rich musical heritage. However, decades of exposure to harsh marine weather had caused damaging decay to external walls and created an annoying acoustic disadvantage for visiting orchestras. Outside, chilly ocean gales generated noisy air turbulence that penetrated through vintage stone crevices. Furthermore, sound engineers noticed an audible cracking vibration when bass instruments resonated against the aging auditorium ceiling. To restore optimal acoustic clarity, the cultural council engaged a team of specialized acoustic architects. The lead designer explained that controlling reverberation is a cardinal principle in hall restoration. Rather than limiting the scope of repairs to surface cosmetics, technicians systematically evaluated the structural sensitivity of internal wall panels. They installed specialized composite dampening layers that absorbed sonic reflections without distorting high vocal notes. During testing, an acoustic sensor confirmed that ambient vibrations had decreased substantially, allowing musical passages to glide smoothly across the tiered auditorium. When the resident orchestra held their trial rehearsal, violin melodies resonated softly throughout the hall with breathtaking warmth. Cleaners swept away all construction debris from the aisles, preparing the auditorium for opening night. Spectators who attended the inaugural gala praised the remarkable clarity of every symphonic movement. Dedicated engineering transformed an acoustic vulnerability into an auditory masterpiece that will elevate cultural life for decades to come. Preserving historic performance spaces requires balancing heritage craftsmanship with scientific rigor. When communities unite to protect their cultural venues, timeless architecture and sublime music continue to inspire generations of appreciative listeners.

passages.title: Observing Changing Natural Elements and Scientific Phenomena
passages.titleVi: Quan sát các yếu tố tự nhiên đang biến đổi và hiện tượng khoa học
passages.text: Scientific exploration begins with acute sensory observation, enabling researchers to distinguish authentic physical properties from mere sensory illusion. Yesterday afternoon, a dedicated meteorological team gathered on an open coastal plateau to observe advancing weather patterns heading inland. In the distance, an incoming bank of storm clouds moved silently across the misty mountain ridgelines. A lone weather observation mast stood firmly on the highest promontory, recording barometric fluctuations with remarkable mechanical reliability. Sensors installed on the mast measured humidity and tracked wind shifts, producing quicker calculation updates than traditional manual instruments. Down along the shoreline, calm ocean waters formed a massive mirror reflecting the changing twilight sky. The shimmering surface created a stunning panoramic vista that captivated researchers before the heavy rainfall arrived. Field researchers collected diverse soil and mineral specimens, placing each into a clearly labeled plastic container for laboratory testing. Geologists carefully examined rock samples under magnifying lenses, noting how moisture alters external mineral texture. A curious apprentice noticed a hollow-sounding echo whenever wind whistled through deep granite fractures. She documented how damp sandstone feels porous and rough, whereas polished quartz retains an exceptionally smooth and dense texture. Earlier analytical models suffered from an inability to predict sudden mountain temperature drops accurately. However, modern computerized sensors and satellite telemetry now provide constant diagnostic verification. Continuous automated monitoring ensures that local authorities receive timely alerts before hazardous storms reach populated valleys. By combining disciplined fieldwork with cutting-edge analytical tools, researchers expand our understanding of natural dynamics. When scientists share objective findings transparently, communities prepare more effectively for severe weather and environmental changes. Every careful observation brings humanity closer to living in harmony with our dynamic planet.

passages.title: Restoring the Heritage Botanical Conservatory
passages.titleVi: Phục hồi nhà kính thực vật di sản
passages.text: Preserving delicate architectural treasures and cultural landmarks requires exceptional patience, specialized craftsmanship, and collaborative community stewardship. Last weekend, dedicated local volunteers and seasoned conservators gathered at the municipal botanical gardens to restore an antique glass greenhouse damaged during severe winter storms. The comprehensive restoration proved to be a consuming endeavor, requiring skilled workers to inspect, scrape, and repaint hundreds of weathered iron joints and timber rafters. Fortunately, mild morning breezes and clear blue skies provided favorable weather conditions for repairing the fragile rooftop framework without sudden rain delays. Artisans handled the fragile antique windowpanes with utmost gentleness, wrapping every piece in protective flannel cloths to avoid catastrophic fractures. On the courtyard terrace below, cleanup crews diligently cleared piles of smashed decorative tiles and fragmented glass shards left by previous seasonal gales. Each replacement glass pane was measured and cut individually by master glaziers to match the intricate curves of the historic Victorian arches. Despite mounting logistical challenges and tight delivery schedules for authentic heritage supplies, the restoration committee remained determined to complete the structural stabilization. Heavy overhead support beams were carefully lowered into place using synchronized mechanical pulleys, ensuring absolute safety for every technician working below. While structural engineers secured the central dome, other community volunteers weeded garden pathways, prepared fertile soil, and planted flowering native shrubs along the stone borders. By late Sunday afternoon, the revitalized pavilion radiated an inviting atmosphere, welcoming neighborhood families with thriving exotic ferns and fragrant blossoming jasmine. Watching the golden twilight illuminate the crystal-clear glass dome across the tranquil park was an unforgettable milestone for everyone who participated. This collaborative conservation effort demonstrates that shared civic devotion can revive irreplaceable heritage landmarks and inspire future generations for decades to come.

passages.title: Weathering the Coastal Storm: Science, Resilience, and Environmental Dynamics
passages.titleVi: Vượt qua bão táp ven biển: Khoa học, khả năng phục hồi và các động lực môi trường
passages.text: Along the rocky northern coastline, researchers from the maritime institute monitor how prolonged seasonal gales influence dynamic marine ecosystems. Last autumn, an aggressive Atlantic storm established temporary atmospheric dominance over the offshore fishing grounds, bringing turbulent squalls and heavy rainfall. As towering tides surged toward the rocky headland, giant crashing waves battered the seawall, threatening to cause severe erosion. The intense hydraulic impact exerted a crushing pressure against the masonry barriers, testing the structural engineering of the harbor. Geological inspectors quickly noticed that a section of the steep promontory had become unstable, with loose boulders tumbling toward the gravel beach. Municipal authorities issued an outright closure of the scenic cliffside trail to ensure visitor safety. Field geologists reviewed the accompanying satellite radar charts to track changing barometric gradients. Inside the mobile observation trailer, telemetry signals experienced interrupted transmission whenever dense storm clouds blocked radio relays. Through the dragging hours of torrential rainfall, researchers observed a distinct repeating pattern in the seismic acoustic pulses. Outside the station, electrical sensors recorded small popping sparks as static electricity accumulated along the metal antenna rods. Senior engineers reminded the field crew that using inferior replacement cables could lead to total telemetry failure during severe gales. By dawn, the coastal gale finally subsided, leaving behind vital meteorological data that will help coastal communities prepare for future ocean storms. Studying environmental patterns with rigorous scientific discipline transforms dangerous natural challenges into actionable civic resilience. Through shared dedication and transparent reporting, the research station continues to safeguard coastal ecosystems against unforeseen climate disruptions.

passages.title: Navigating Challenges and Restoring Harmony in Field Operations
passages.titleVi: Vượt qua thử thách và tái lập sự hòa hợp trong các hoạt động thực địa
passages.text: Organizing successful ecological fieldwork in remote areas requires thorough preparation, unwavering discipline, and adaptive problem-solving when unexpected difficulties emerge. Last spring, our environmental conservation team faced unprecedented seasonal floods that inundated the lower river basin far beyond historical flood levels. Before leaving base camp, researchers met to verify that their equipment was packed and calibrated beforehand, as experienced scientists customarily do before launching challenging expeditions. The expedition leader emphasized that team priorities must remain strictly aligned with regional conservation mandates, focusing primarily on protecting endangered wetland species and monitoring toxic water contamination. Upon reaching the research perimeter, the team encountered extremely difficult terrain, navigating treacherous muddy footpaths where heavy supply vehicles were completely unable to travel. Setting up a temporary observation shelter beside a noisy diesel generator created acoustic challenges, but dedicated technicians worked diligently to ensure that sensitive seismic and hydraulic sensors were calibrated correctly. Throughout the demanding day, field biologists continued gathering water samples and recording environmental metrics regardless of the relentless cold drizzle and physical exhaustion. Recognizing that trivial administrative paperwork was completely unimportant during an active environmental emergency, the supervisors urged everyone to concentrate fully on vital wildlife rescue operations. By dusk, the swollen waters began receding, revealing that disciplined teamwork had preserved critical sensor arrays and safely shielded delicate nesting grounds. Approaching demanding tasks with rigorous planning, mutual trust, and clear communication turns unforeseen environmental crises into valuable opportunities for community resilience and scientific discovery. Every team member returned safely to base camp, feeling proud of their collective dedication during this difficult assignment.

passages.title: The Investigation at the Historic Manor
passages.titleVi: Cuộc điều tra tại trang viên lịch sử
passages.text: High on a mist-covered hill overlooking the coastal valley stood an imposing stone manor built more than two centuries ago. Last month, an architectural restoration team arrived to survey the property after seasonal storms had heavily impacted its outer stone battlements. Walking up the steep pathway, researchers noticed that rainy weather had made the flagstone steps slick and hazardous. Tall oak trees cast dark, shady contours over the overgrown gardens, creating an atmosphere of mysterious secrecy. The lead inspector discovered that decades of roof leaks were slowly ruining several irreplaceable fresco paintings inside the grand library. During their detailed inspection, historical investigators uncovered a hidden wooden compartment beneath the floorboards of the private study. Inside this secret drawer, they found confidential journals detailing a serious property dispute that occurred between competing merchant families in the Victorian era. Earlier rumor suggested that original deed documents had completely vanished during a mysterious fire in nineteen twenty. However, the newly discovered records proved that multiple local officials were directly involved in concealing the true ownership records. The restoration crew regarded the discovery as an awesome breakthrough that solved a century-old historical puzzle. Standing on the manor terrace at sunset, team members admired an amazing panoramic view of the golden river valley stretching beneath them. Furthermore, analyzing ancient masonry mortar allows modern builders to replicate authentic structural techniques when repairing stone walls. Visitors who explore the estate now appreciate not only its architectural grandeur but also the resilient spirit of preservation that brought it back to life. Careful preservation of historic monuments ensures that valuable cultural lessons remain accessible to future generations. When dedicated historians and engineers collaborate with patience and integrity, forgotten community stories are safely restored to light.

sentencePairs.vi: Việc bảo tồn cẩn thận các di tích lịch sử đảm bảo rằng những bài học văn hóa quý giá vẫn luôn tiếp cận được với các thế hệ tương lai.

sentencePairs.en: When dedicated historians and engineers collaborate with patience and integrity, forgotten community stories are safely restored to light.
sentencePairs.vi: Khi các nhà sử học và kỹ sư tận tâm hợp tác với sự kiên nhẫn và chính trực, những câu chuyện cộng đồng bị lãng quên sẽ được đưa ra ánh sáng một cách an toàn.

pronunciationNotesVi: Từ 'imposing' phát âm là /ɪmˈpoʊ.zɪŋ/, trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết thứ hai với nguyên âm đôi /oʊ/.
Từ 'uncovered' phát âm là /ʌnˈkʌv.ɚd/, trọng âm nhấn ở âm tiết thứ hai 'cov' với nguyên âm ngắn /ʌ/.
Từ 'vanished' có đuôi '-ed' phát âm là /t/: /ˈvæn.ɪʃt/, trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết đầu 'van'.
Từ 'awesome' phát âm là /ˈɑː.səm/, trọng âm nhấn ở âm tiết đầu với nguyên âm dài /ɑː/.

comprehensionQuestions.question: What had seasonal storms done to the stone manor before the restoration team arrived?
options: They had heavily impacted its outer stone battlements
They had completely submerged the entire manor under deep ocean water
They had caused a massive volcanic lava flow over the gardens
They had demolished all interior walls into dust
comprehensionQuestions.explanationVi: Đoạn văn nêu rõ: 'seasonal storms had heavily impacted its outer stone battlements'.

comprehensionQuestions.question: What did historical investigators find inside the hidden wooden compartment beneath the floorboards?
options: Confidential journals detailing a serious Victorian-era property dispute
A treasure chest filled with gold coins and pirate maps
Modern electronic surveillance equipment and batteries
Medical vials containing emergency antivenom serum
comprehensionQuestions.explanationVi: Bài đọc cho biết: 'Inside this secret drawer, they found confidential journals detailing a serious property dispute that occurred between competing merchant families in the Victorian era'.

comprehensionQuestions.question: What did the newly discovered records prove regarding the deed documents thought to have vanished?
options: Multiple local officials were directly involved in concealing the true ownership records
The documents were taken by foreign tourists to an overseas museum
The papers were accidentally eaten by farm livestock
The original deeds were entirely fictional and never written
comprehensionQuestions.explanationVi: Trong bài viết khẳng định: 'the newly discovered records proved that multiple local officials were directly involved in concealing the true ownership records'.

passages.title: Evaluating Materials and Integrity in the Precision Workshop
passages.titleVi: Đánh giá vật liệu và độ chuẩn xác trong xưởng cơ khí chính xác
passages.text: In the modern engineering laboratory, evaluating raw industrial materials requires solving complex technical challenges. Technicians tested structural prototypes under heavy stress loads to ensure zero mechanical damage during high-pressure operations. Implementing an effective quality control audit allowed inspectors to identify defective alloy components before final product assembly. Inspectors immediately rejected shipments containing cheap fake metal coatings that failed baseline corrosion standards. Senior metallurgists maintained a firm refusal to compromise on strict manufacturing tolerances. They selected high-grade ductile iron forgings known for their outstanding tensile strength and long-lasting durability. Senior researchers recognized the enormous potential of newly developed composite alloys for aerospace applications. Engineers subjected turbine housings to extreme temperature chambers to confirm they were heat-proof and impact-resistant. Chemical spectrometers verified that the titanium ore was completely pure, containing negligible mineral impurities. Discovering deposits of such exceptionally rare mineral crystals represented a signal breakthrough for sustainable energy research. Apprentices anchored the heavy machinery securely onto a solid granite platform to absorb excessive mechanical vibrations. When an automated conveyor belt became stuck due to debris, maintenance operators paused the line safely to clear the jam. Laboratory supervisors regularly organize training workshops to familiarize apprentice technicians with sophisticated ultrasonic testing apparatus. Through meticulous inspection and empirical rigor, the facility prevents costly operational failures before commercial equipment enters service. Careful measurement and calibrated instruments ensure that every manufactured part operates reliably in demanding industrial environments. By upholding uncompromising standards of craftsmanship, the precision workshop guarantees safety and technological excellence for global clients. These enduring values inspire the next generation of engineers to strive for perfection in every single endeavor.

sentencePairs.en: In the modern engineering laboratory, evaluating raw industrial materials requires solving complex technical challenges.
sentencePairs.vi: Trong phòng thí nghiệm kỹ thuật hiện đại, việc đánh giá các vật liệu công nghiệp thô đòi hỏi phải giải quyết những thách thức kỹ thuật phức tạp.

sentencePairs.en: Technicians tested structural prototypes under heavy stress loads to ensure zero mechanical damage during high-pressure operations.
sentencePairs.vi: Các kỹ thuật viên đã thử nghiệm các nguyên mẫu kết cấu dưới tải trọng ứng suất lớn để đảm bảo không có hư hại cơ học nào trong các hoạt động áp suất cao.

sentencePairs.en: Implementing an effective quality control audit allowed inspectors to identify defective alloy components before final product assembly.
sentencePairs.vi: Việc triển khai một cuộc kiểm toán kiểm soát chất lượng hiệu quả đã cho phép các thanh tra viên xác định các thành phần hợp kim bị lỗi trước khi lắp ráp sản phẩm cuối cùng.

sentencePairs.en: Inspectors immediately rejected shipments containing cheap fake metal coatings that failed baseline corrosion standards.
sentencePairs.vi: Các thanh tra viên ngay lập tức từ chối các lô hàng chứa các lớp phủ kim loại giả rẻ tiền không đạt các tiêu chuẩn chống ăn mòn cơ bản.

sentencePairs.en: Senior metallurgists maintained a firm refusal to compromise on strict manufacturing tolerances.
sentencePairs.vi: Các chuyên gia luyện kim cao cấp kiên quyết từ chối thỏa hiệp về dung sai sản xuất nghiêm ngặt.

sentencePairs.en: They selected high-grade ductile iron forgings known for their outstanding tensile strength and long-lasting durability.
sentencePairs.vi: Họ đã lựa chọn các phôi rèn sắt dẻo cao cấp nổi tiếng với độ bền kéo vượt trội và tuổi thọ lâu dài.

sentencePairs.en: Senior researchers recognized the enormous potential of newly developed composite alloys for aerospace applications.
sentencePairs.vi: Các nhà nghiên cứu cấp cao đã nhận ra tiềm năng to lớn của các hợp kim composite mới được phát triển cho các ứng dụng hàng không vũ trụ.

sentencePairs.en: Engineers subjected turbine housings to extreme temperature chambers to confirm they were heat-proof and impact-resistant.
sentencePairs.vi: Các kỹ sư đã đưa vỏ tuabin vào các buồng nhiệt độ cực đoan để xác nhận rằng chúng chịu nhiệt và chống va đập tốt.

sentencePairs.en: Chemical spectrometers verified that the titanium ore was completely pure, containing negligible mineral impurities.
sentencePairs.vi: Các máy quang phổ hóa học đã xác minh rằng quặng titan hoàn toàn tinh khiết, chỉ chứa các tạp chất khoáng không đáng kể.

sentencePairs.en: Discovering deposits of such exceptionally rare mineral crystals represented a signal breakthrough for sustainable energy research.
sentencePairs.vi: Việc phát hiện các mỏ tinh thể khoáng chất đặc biệt hiếm có như vậy đại diện cho một bước đột phá mang tính bước ngoặt cho nghiên cứu năng lượng bền vững.

sentencePairs.en: Apprentices anchored the heavy machinery securely onto a solid granite platform to absorb excessive mechanical vibrations.
sentencePairs.vi: Các học việc đã neo chặt máy móc nặng nề vào một bệ đá hoa cương vững chắc để hấp thụ các rung động cơ học quá mức.

sentencePairs.en: When an automated conveyor belt became stuck due to debris, maintenance operators paused the line safely to clear the jam.
sentencePairs.vi: Khi băng chuyền tự động bị mắc kẹt do mảnh vụn, người vận hành bảo trì đã tạm dừng dây chuyền một cách an toàn để xử lý chỗ kẹt.

sentencePairs.en: Laboratory supervisors regularly organize training workshops to familiarize apprentice technicians with sophisticated ultrasonic testing apparatus.
sentencePairs.vi: Các giám sát viên phòng thí nghiệm thường xuyên tổ chức các buổi hội thảo đào tạo để giúp các kỹ thuật viên học việc làm quen với thiết bị kiểm tra siêu âm tinh vi.

sentencePairs.en: Through meticulous inspection and empirical rigor, the facility prevents costly operational failures before commercial equipment enters service.
sentencePairs.vi: Thông qua sự kiểm tra tỉ mỉ và tính nghiêm ngặt thực nghiệm, cơ sở này ngăn ngừa các sự cố vận hành tốn kém trước khi thiết bị thương mại đi vào hoạt động.

sentencePairs.en: Careful measurement and calibrated instruments ensure that every manufactured part operates reliably in demanding industrial environments.
sentencePairs.vi: Việc đo lường cẩn thận và các dụng cụ đã được hiệu chuẩn đảm bảo rằng mọi bộ phận được sản xuất đều hoạt động đáng tin cậy trong các môi trường công nghiệp khắt khe.

sentencePairs.en: By upholding uncompromising standards of craftsmanship, the precision workshop guarantees safety and technological excellence for global clients.
sentencePairs.vi: Bằng cách giữ vững các tiêu chuẩn tay nghề không khoan nhượng, xưởng cơ khí chính xác đảm bảo sự an toàn và chất lượng công nghệ vượt trội cho khách hàng toàn cầu.

sentencePairs.en: These enduring values inspire the next generation of engineers to strive for perfection in every single endeavor.
sentencePairs.vi: Những giá trị trường tồn này truyền cảm hứng cho thế hệ kỹ sư tiếp theo nỗ lực hướng tới sự hoàn hảo trong từng công việc.

pronunciationNotesVi: Từ 'complex' phát âm là /ˈkɑːm.pleks/, trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết đầu tiên 'com' với nguyên âm /ɑː/.
Từ 'potential' phát âm là /pəˈten.ʃəl/, trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết thứ hai với âm /ʃ/ mềm.
Từ 'signal' trong ngữ cảnh tính từ phát âm là /ˈsɪɡ.nəl/, trọng âm rơi vào âm tiết đầu.
Cụm 'became stuck' có sự nối âm tự nhiên giữa phụ âm khép /m/ và phụ âm /st/: /bɪˈkeɪm stʌk/.

comprehensionQuestions.question: Why did inspectors reject certain incoming shipments?
options: Because they contained cheap fake metal coatings that failed corrosion standards
Because the delivery trucks arrived after midnight
Because the supplier failed to include colorful advertising brochures
Because the metal parts were painted in the wrong decorative color
comprehensionQuestions.explanationVi: Đoạn văn nêu rõ: 'Inspectors immediately rejected shipments containing cheap fake metal coatings that failed baseline corrosion standards'.

comprehensionQuestions.question: What did chemical spectrometers confirm about the titanium ore?
options: That the ore was completely pure with negligible mineral impurities
That the ore was mixed with household plastic trash
That the ore was completely radioactive and unusable
That the ore was made of wood sawdust
comprehensionQuestions.explanationVi: Bài đọc nêu rõ: 'Chemical spectrometers verified that the titanium ore was completely pure, containing negligible mineral impurities'.

comprehensionQuestions.question: What did maintenance operators do when the automated conveyor belt became stuck?
options: They paused the line safely to clear the jam
They permanently abandoned the entire factory facility
They increased the speed of the conveyor belt to maximum
They turned off all the city's power plants
comprehensionQuestions.explanationVi: Đoạn văn viết: 'When an automated conveyor belt became stuck due to debris, maintenance operators paused the line safely to clear the jam'.
